$comment: Crack tile sets (docs/BLOCK_DAMAGE.md §6.3, WORK_QUEUE item 18): per material family, its crack stages in order, hairline to branching. Each name is an atlas tile painted by materials.json (a white tile with dark strokes, multiplied over a damaged block's faces, centred on where it was struck: the tile spans `span` m round the hit). A block's `damage.look.cracks.set` names a set here; its `stages` give the damage fraction each tile starts at.
